chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: This saying has already appeared elsewhere in this chapter, except that here it is clearer and more detailed. This is why we have repeated it according to the principle laid down in the beginning of the book.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرِّضْيُ: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī, the compiler of the sermons in Nahj al-Balagha

ai.seo_question: Why does As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī repeat the discussion on divine predestination in this section of Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Raḍī justifies the repetition of this discourse on divine predestination (qada' wa qadar) by emphasizing its enhanced clarity and depth in this specific context, adhering to the editorial principle of prioritizing comprehensiveness. This structural choice reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of valuing both the conciseness of the original sermons and the pedagogical benefit of detailed elaboration for the reader's spiritual understanding.
